title: Habitat Schoolhouse Preschool Workbook 6 — Part 1 (Letters V, W + Number Stacking + Word Tracing)
publisher: The Habitat Schoolhouse Inc / Gumboot Kid

newActivityTypes.description: Vv themed: 'Number Stacking — Stack blocks, rocks, cups, legos or other stackable objects you have on the following numbers.' 3x3 grid of pastel-colored number cards (1-9, scrambled order) against a watercolor sky/meadow background. Child reads the number, then stacks that many physical objects on the card.
newActivityTypes.skill: number recognition (1-9), counting, one-to-one correspondence, fine motor
newActivityTypes.recipeNote: NEW manipulative activity — the page is a SURFACE for stacking objects. Lamination-ready. Numbers scrambled (not sequential) to test recognition, not just counting up.

newActivityTypes.description: Ww themed: 'White — Draw something that is white.' Large blank drawing area on top half. Bottom: 'Trace the word white.' with dotted-line word on three-line guide. Combines creative drawing + color concept + word tracing.
newActivityTypes.skill: creative expression, color concepts, word tracing, early writing
newActivityTypes.recipeNote: NEW — the child DRAWS a concept (something white) then WRITES the word for it. Drawing before writing = concrete before abstract.

seriesProgression.WB1: sensory/kinesthetic (paint, playdough, placing objects, counting to 5)
seriesProgression.WB2: nonfiction reading + science diagrams + geographic vocabulary
seriesProgression.WB5: anatomy labels, uppercase/lowercase sorting, comprehension questions
seriesProgression.WB6: number stacking (1-9), word tracing, draw-concept prompts — the MOST abstract/advanced

gaps.name: number-stacking-mat
gaps.description: A grid of number cards (scrambled, not sequential) designed as a manipulative surface. Child places/stacks that many physical objects on each number. Lamination-ready. Background is watercolor nature scene.

gaps.name: draw-and-trace-word
gaps.description: A two-part page: top half = open drawing area with concept prompt ('Draw something that is [color/shape/feeling]'). Bottom half = trace the word with dotted letters on three-line guide. Combines creative expression with early writing.

notes: Fourth Habitat Schoolhouse workbook (WB1, WB2, WB5, WB6 now in collection). WB6 is the FINAL workbook — the Pond Map record-keeping set says WB6 → 'Register in: Kindergarten.' New activity types: number stacking mats (manipulative surface for 1-9) and draw-and-trace-word pages (drawing + word writing). The full series progression is now mapped: WB1 (hands-on) → WB2 (nonfiction + diagrams) → WB5 (sorting + comprehension) → WB6 (word tracing + number recognition). The arc goes from concrete/sensory to abstract/symbolic — exactly the Montessori concrete-to-abstract principle.
